title: 快速连续切换三个会话
description: 在很短的间隔里依次打开三个真实会话，最后停留在第三个。检查不会串台（主区域显示最后一个标题）、没有未捕获异常，切换后侧栏选中态跟随。
preconditions: 至少三个可见的短标题会话。
expectations: 最后打开哪个会话，主区域就显示哪个
切换过程中不出现异常或空白
侧边栏选中态与主区域一致

db.sql: SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 10) WHERE length(title) <= 16 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0

SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 10) WHERE length(title) <= 16 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 10) WHERE length(title) <= 16 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2

assert.message: 主区域显示最后打开的会话

assert.expr: (() => { const selected = [...document.querySelectorAll('[aria-selected=true],[data-selected=true]')].map(el => el.getAttribute('aria-label') || el.innerText).join(' '); return selected.includes('{{c}}') || selected.length === 0; })()
assert.message: 侧栏选中态没有停在旧会话（允许无 aria-selected 的实现）
